title: Ticket
description: Emitting site: dict(sqlite3.Row) over `tickets` in ticketd/app/server.py:37,64,74. Every DB column is serialized, no field is excluded.

slug.description: Derived via slugify() (ticketd/app/util.py:4-6). NOT guaranteed unique — see PB-003/OQ-001. NOT guaranteed non-empty or hyphen-free at the boundary either (P9 audit finding, verified 2026-08-09): a title that is non-empty-after-.strip() but all-punctuation (e.g. "!!!") slugifies to "" (util.py's re.sub collapses to a single '-', then .strip('-') removes it -- create_ticket's only validation is whitespace-.strip(), which does not catch this). Separately, .strip('-') runs BEFORE the [:64] truncation in util.py:6, so a title whose 64th slugified character would land on a hyphen produces a slug ending in '-' (e.g. 'a'*63 + ' ' + 'b'*5 -> 64 'a's + trailing '-'). Both verified by direct execution of the real slugify() body. A pattern like ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ (which this schema previously declared) is therefore FALSE for real legacy output and was removed rather than left silently wrong -- do not re-add it without also changing slugify()'s behavior (which would be an unsanctioned change, no PB entry covers this).

priority.description: Stored value is always low/med/high after app-layer coercion on create, but no re-validation happens on read -- schema reflects the DB CHECK constraint, not a stronger app-level guarantee.
